=== ROOT CAUSE (iter680 Q4 DECIMAL money scored 3.00 FLAGGED) ===
The DECIMAL(18,2)/sum-widens-to-38/overflow-NUMERIC_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE conceptual guidance was CORRECT, but the responder's CREATE TABLE included `PRIMARY KEY (order_id)` which PARSE-FAILS in Trino. The responder followed the WRONG `r03:465` claim ('Iceberg connector accepts PRIMARY KEY syntax only as documentation metadata') and produced parse-broken DDL.

=== r03:465 BEFORE (verbatim, the wrong claim) ===
'The Iceberg connector accepts PRIMARY KEY syntax only as documentation metadata — it is NOT enforced and creates NO index. There is no implicit-index behavior on Trino + Iceberg.'

=== r03:465 AFTER (the docs-correct fix) ===
Full two-layer correction stating (a) Trino 467 CREATE TABLE grammar has NO PRIMARY KEY/FOREIGN KEY/UNIQUE/CHECK syntax at all, (b) writing `(order_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, ...)` fails at PARSE TIME with `mismatched input 'PRIMARY'. Expecting: ')', ',', 'COMMENT', 'NOT', 'WITH'`, (c) the connector does NOT parse-and-ignore the keyword and does NOT store it as metadata, (d) the SQL never reaches the connector layer, (e) workarounds: `NOT NULL` + `COMMENT` + dbt MERGE `unique_key` + dbt `unique` test. Cross-ref to the r23 canonical added in STEP 3.

=== STEP 3 — CANONICAL PLACEMENT ===
New §'Trino 467 CREATE TABLE: what IS vs IS NOT supported — NO PRIMARY KEY / FOREIGN KEY / UNIQUE / CHECK / DEFAULT' inserted at r23:27 (immediately after the myths-table cross-ref, before §1). Picked r23 over r27 as the higher-traffic CREATE TABLE landing (r23 is the general SQL best-practices home; r27 is Oracle-migration-specific).
  • Keyword anchors: Trino CREATE TABLE primary key, Iceberg primary key Trino, primary key constraint Trino, foreign key Trino, unique constraint Trino, check constraint Trino, DEFAULT value Trino column, AUTO_INCREMENT Trino, SERIAL Trino, IDENTITY column Trino, money table DDL, CREATE TABLE constraint, mismatched input 'PRIMARY', NOT NULL Trino, COMMENT column Trino, orders table CREATE TABLE Trino, DECIMAL money column DDL.
  • SUPPORTED table: NOT NULL (enforced), COMMENT (metadata), WITH (table+column properties), CTAS.
  • NOT SUPPORTED table (PARSE-ERROR): PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE, CHECK, DEFAULT, AUTO_INCREMENT/SERIAL/GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, INDEX, CONSTRAINT name PRIMARY KEY (named constraint form).
  • Worked CORRECT money/orders DDL: `CREATE TABLE iceberg.analytics.orders (order_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'logical primary key — uniqueness enforced via dbt unique test', customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'FK -> customers.customer_id', amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'cents-exact', status VARCHAR NOT NULL, order_date DATE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL) WITH (format='PARQUET', partitioning=ARRAY['month(order_date)'], sorted_by=ARRAY['order_id ASC'])`.
  • Paired with dbt schema.yml tests (`not_null`, `unique`, `relationships`, `dbt_utils.expression_is_true`) to recover the constraint enforcement.
  • Paired with model SELECT-side COALESCE pattern to replace DDL `DEFAULT` clauses.
  • Cross-refs to r03 (index myth row), r27 §4.5A (identity column), r27 §4.5D (uuid + Iceberg-PK fabrications), r27 §6 (dbt YAML contracts as the separate metadata layer).

=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED (WebFetch on 2026-06-08) ===
• trino.io/docs/467/sql/create-table.html — full grammar synopsis:
    CREATE [OR REPLACE] TABLE [IF NOT EXISTS] table_name (
      { column_name data_type [NOT NULL] [COMMENT comment] [WITH (property_name = expression [, ...])]
      | LIKE existing_table_name [{INCLUDING | EXCLUDING} PROPERTIES] }
      [, ...]
    )
    [COMMENT table_comment]
    [WITH (property_name = expression [, ...])]
  → Confirms NO PRIMARY KEY, NO FOREIGN KEY, NO UNIQUE, NO CHECK, NO DEFAULT in the grammar.
  → Confirms NOT NULL IS supported (only column constraint).
  → Confirms COMMENT (column + table) IS supported.
  → Confirms WITH (...) IS supported (column + table properties).
  → Confirms LIKE existing_table_name IS supported.
• trino.io/docs/467/connector/iceberg.html — confirms 'The Iceberg connector supports setting NOT NULL constraints on the table columns'; NO mention of PRIMARY KEY / FOREIGN KEY / UNIQUE / CHECK / DEFAULT.
• Parse error wording confirmed via Trino parser test harness pattern: `mismatched input 'PRIMARY'. Expecting: ')', ',', 'COMMENT', 'NOT', 'WITH'`.
• Dialect-pinning: PIN_TRINO_467 list extended with CREATE-TABLE-PRIMARY-KEY-parse-fails inoculation (covered in iter671 dialect-locks).
